notes.title: Special promotion offer and update-09/21/16
notes.content:
Special promotion offer! 50% discount for 2 weeks!

Adjustment on BOSS: in higher levels, we’ve lowered the HP and ATK of some BOSSes, and increased their skill frequency in exchange. We’re sure this would speed up the battle pace.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/489170

In-game poster changed: the in-game poster has been changed into our new game “Galaxy Reavers”, which will be released on Sep.19th.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6997826/b695ba6b4835b23731bf06bbd7c1327fb305cea9.jpg

“Galaxy Reavers” is a fun yet challenging full-dimension star war RTS on PC platform. Players will build up their own fleet and equip each warship to conquer other planets and expand their territory. Survive and strive in the enormous galaxy!

Thank you for supporting us!

notes.title: The World II (Hunting BOSS) update-21/07/2016
notes.content:
1. More epic bosses await you! The bosses have grown stronger in high-level quests. The higher level you reach,the stronger bosses there are! Come and hunt these epic bosses!
2. AI teammates have become smarter! During high-level quests,you will find them more powerful, and thus more reliable.
3. GUI Optimization: the UI buttons are simplified and now more convenient to use.
4. Loading Optimization: loading will be faster with a new Loading Page.
5. Bug fixed: we have fixed the bug that would cause crush during long-time battle.

Last but not least,we are thrilled to tell all hunters,our latest 3D Star Wars like  RTS game "Galaxy Reavers" is upcoming soon on steam platform! 

Please stay tuned on our Facebook:  https://www.facebook.com/GalaxyReavers

Thank you and have fun! 
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6997826/29f6ebf4198f6c29c5b80de48bc5463989510265.png
